note: Run-side data only (no plotting). mean_step_ms excludes the first 2 warmup steps. peak_mem_mib_* sampled via nvidia-smi during the run. Stages with status!='ok' did not train. mem_report is the trainer's own exact allocation accounting (LLMM_MEM_REPORT): byte-precise per-buffer sizes read off the live DeviceBuffers, per rank, at two phases — 'post_alloc' (params/grads/optimizer/ZeRO-3 windows, before activations are sized) and 'steady' (after the last step). Unlike peak_mem_mib_*, which nvidia-smi quantizes to the allocator's ~256 MiB commit granularity, mem_report resolves changes far below that. It counts only device buffers owned by the model and the ZeRO context; the cuBLASLt workspace, the persistent_device_buffer globals, the KVCache-cached attention GEMM scratch, and pinned host buffers are NOT included, so exact_total < driver_used always.
